warning.titlePre: Range Rover Autobiography Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: The L460-generation Range Rover Autobiography uses BMW-sourced V8s. The specific engine fitted depends on the vehicle's spec, and each carries its own well-documented characteristics.

If your Autobiography has the BMW N63 (standard V8 tier): The N63 is a "hot-vee" design, which has a documented pattern of valve seal wear, cooling system leaks (particularly coolant lines), and higher-than-average oil consumption on some examples. We replace valve seals, coolant components and timing chain components as standard on every N63 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: BMW G-BRF N63/S63 family pattern, cross-applicable per VRF-landrover-range-rover.md, confirmed via Wikipedia L460 article. Both V8s are BMW-sourced and carry the hot-vee family pattern
